exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'either … or'.

questions.question: She can have tea. Or she can have coffee. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: She can have either tea or coffee
Either she can tea or coffee
She either have tea or coffee
questions.answer: She can have either tea or coffee
questions.explanation: Place 'either' before the first alternative and 'or' before the second. 'Can have' stays at the beginning. 'Either … or' ကို noun နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He keeps the keys himself. Or he leaves them with his wife. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: He either keeps the keys himself or leaves them with his wife
Either he keeps the keys or himself leaves them
He keeps either the keys himself or his wife
questions.answer: He either keeps the keys himself or leaves them with his wife
questions.explanation: When both clauses share the same subject, place 'either' before the first verb. 'Either … or' ကို verb phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He may attend the function. Or his wife may attend the function. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: Either he or his wife may attend the function
He may either attend his wife or the function
Either he attends or his wife the function
questions.answer: Either he or his wife may attend the function
questions.explanation: Use 'Either + subject + or + subject' before the verb. The two subjects are joined by 'either … or'. 'Either … or' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Give me freedom. Or give me death. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: Give me either freedom or death
Either give me freedom or death
Give either me freedom or me death
questions.answer: Give me either freedom or death
questions.explanation: Place 'either' before the first alternative and 'or' before the second within the object. 'Either … or' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He must have done this. Or his brother must have done this. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: Either he or his brother must have done this
He must either have done this or his brother
Either he or his brother done this must have
questions.answer: Either he or his brother must have done this
questions.explanation: Use 'Either + subject + or + subject' before the modal verb. 'Either … or' ကို subject နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: She will weep. Or she will die. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: She will either weep or die
Either she weeps or dies will
She either will weep or will die
questions.answer: She will either weep or die
questions.explanation: When both clauses share the same subject, place 'either' between the modal verb and the first verb. 'Either … or' ကို verb နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: He is a fool. He is a mad man to accept this task. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: He is either a fool or a mad man to accept this task
Either he is a fool or mad man a task
He is a either fool or a mad man
questions.answer: He is either a fool or a mad man to accept this task
questions.explanation: Place 'either' after the verb 'is' and before the first noun phrase, with 'or' before the second. 'Either … or' ကို noun phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: Nick can play golf. Nick can play football. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: Nick can play either golf or football
Either Nick can play golf or football
Nick either can play golf or football
questions.answer: Nick can play either golf or football
questions.explanation: Place 'either' before the first object and 'or' before the second. The subject and auxiliary stay at the beginning. 'Either … or' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: You can write with a pen. You can write with a pencil. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: You can write with either a pen or a pencil
Either you can write with a pen or pencil
You can either write with a pen or a pencil
questions.answer: You can write with either a pen or a pencil
questions.explanation: Place 'either' before the first prepositional phrase alternative and 'or' before the second. 'Either … or' ကို prepositional phrase နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.question: My mom likes mangoes. Or she likes bananas. Combine using 'either … or'.
options: My mom likes either mangoes or bananas
Either my mom likes mangoes or bananas
My mom either likes mangoes or she likes bananas
questions.answer: My mom likes either mangoes or bananas
questions.explanation: Place 'either' before the first object and 'or' before the second. The subject and verb stay at the beginning. 'Either … or' ကို object နှစ်ခုကြားမှာ ထားပါ။
